lighthouse_detail: full audits captured (DataForSEO lighthouse/live/json returns full audit payload; raw files not committed)
environment_caveats: First audit on the apex (apex_cutover.completed_at 2026-09-08). The prior run (2026-08-26) audited the Cloudflare Pages staging preview. Regression comparison matches URLs by path across the two origins; SEO deltas (+31) reflect removal of the staging noindex artifact, not a site change.
Apex response has no x-robots-tag header; SEO counts toward the verdict this run.
Lighthouse ran DESKTOP only (for_mobile=false) to stay comparable with the August desktop baseline. Mobile scores typically run 10-20 performance points lower.

The named MCP tools on_page_lighthouse and on_page_instant_pages are not exposed by this DataForSEO MCP build. Used authenticated REST calls to /v3/on_page/lighthouse/live/json and /v3/on_page/instant_pages. Same data, same cost basis.
Service-landing slot: fire-damage-restoration, mold-remediation, and water-damage-restoration tie at priority 9.0. Kept water + fire (same pair as August) for regression continuity.

Service-area slot: no primary:true entry and the HQ city (Santa Maria) has no service-area page (/service-areas/santa-maria-ca/ 301s to /). Fell back to the first area slug, /service-areas/vandenberg-village-ca/, matching August.
Issue IDs prefixed rankai_ are Rank AI derived checks, not vendor IDs. has_micromarkup_errors is a DataForSEO boolean with no per-error detail in instant_pages.
